versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Publisher skill for PushWebly publishing platform.

- Publish local HTML frontend projects to PushWebly, with support for public/private visibility and shareable URLs.
- Package published projects into Android APKs.
- List all published projects and toggle their visibility (public/private, with optional password).
- Support login and registration flows with username/password.
- Provides strict step-by-step, user-driven publishing flows with blocking finite-state machine for information capture.
- Updated intent mapping to clarify supported actions and enforce information-gathering order.
